notes.title: Cock 2.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed game not running when minimized/not in focus.

This should fix the issue of not receiving any drops while idle, and the "Lucky cock" achievement taking too long to unlock.

notes.title: Cock 2.0.0
notes.content:
Fixed drops.

Game runs on Unity now instead of Tauri.
